name: deck-config
body: `kalide.yaml` holds deck-wide config: `title` (required), optional `author` (presenter), optional `date` written as `YYYY-MM-DD`, optional `theme` (default `default`), and optional `navigation` (default|linear|grid, default `default`). Missing `title` = error; `date` not in `YYYY-MM-DD` form = error; unknown keys = error with closest-match suggestion (consistent with field rules); wrong types = error. The legacy file name `eypres.yaml` is not recognised (hard cut; see kalide-rename).
